label: Zalo
terms_note: Official Account (business) API, OAuth v4 (app granted on the OA; 1 h access tokens refreshed at oauth.zaloapp.com/v4/oa/access_token with secret_key). From the Social client's 2026-09-02 read (not re-verifiable today because developers.zalo.me renders client-side behind Turnstile): consultation messages (Tin Tư vấn) to a user who interacted within the API window ('first 8 messages free within 48 h' then per-message fee), transaction messages by template, promotion messages to followers only (≤4 per follower per month), broadcast via article create → verify → oa/message; registry note: broadcast hours 06:00-19:59. Responses {error, message, data} with non-zero error on HTTP 200; HTTP 429 on quota.

sdks: No official SDK found; plain HTTPS against openapi.zalo.me (developers.zalo.me)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**, confidence **medium**: developers.zalo.me is a client-rendered shell behind Cloudflare

endpoints.notes: ≤ 4 per follower per month, within the OA package; registry: broadcast 06:00-19:59

reference.limits: - Responses `{error, message, data}`; non-zero `error` with HTTP 200 IS an error; quota codes (-32 / -209 style) and HTTP 429. - OA (business) accounts only; personal Zalo accounts have no API. Terms and rate-limit pages unreadable by automation.

fields.name: app_id
fields.help: ID of your Zalo app (developers.zalo.me > app > Thông tin ứng dụng).

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: The app's secret key (Khóa bí mật của ứng dụng); sent only as the secret_key header of the token request.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: OA refresh_token from the OA authorisation (POST https://oauth.zaloapp.com/v4/oa/access_token with grant_type=authorization_code). Valid 3 months and single-use: each refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set). Access tokens last 25 h.

me.note: GET /v2.0/oa/getoa: the OA's id, name, description, is_verified, num_follower, package.

list_inbound.note: GET /v2.0/oa/listrecentchat: the latest message of each recent conversation (max 10 per page; offset 0 = most recent). src 1 = from the user, 0 = from the OA; `from`/`to` are user or OA ids and a user's id is the thread_id for get_thread/reply; sent_at is epoch ms. Needs the 'Quyền quản lý tin nhắn người dùng' permission.

get_thread.note: GET /v2.0/oa/conversation: messages between the OA and one user (thread_id = the user's user_id), newest first, max 10 per page.

send.note: POST /v3.0/oa/message/cs: a consultation (Tin Tư vấn) text message, ≤2000 characters, to a user_id who follows or has interacted with the OA; free within 48 h of the user's last interaction, otherwise it consumes the OA's quota. `subject` is ignored.

reply.note: Replies in a conversation by sending a consultation text message to the thread's user (thread_id = user_id).

not_offered.mark_read: The OA message-management APIs (https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/quan-ly-tin-nhan/lay-thong-tin-tin-nhan-gan-nhat and siblings: recent chats, conversation, quota, uploads) have no mark-as-read call.

adapter.terms: Zalo Official Account API (https://developers.zalo.me/docs/official-account/): every call carries the OA access_token header; failures are {error: <non-zero>, message} in 200 bodies. Access tokens (25 h) are minted from the rotating single-use refresh token at https://oauth.zaloapp.com/v4/oa/access_token (form refresh_token, app_id, grant_type; secret_key header; https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/bat-dau/xac-thuc-va-uy-quyen-cho-ung-dung-new).

evidence: host openapi.zalo.me: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 200 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
